description: This file defines a class Req with static methods to access various types of request data such as GET, POST, Cookie, Header, JSON payload, Session, and a placeholder for file handling.

classes.name: Req
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve HTTP request parameters and headers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a value from the $_GET superglobal array, returns null if not set or empty.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Retrieve a value from the $_POST superglobal array, returns null if not set or empty.

methods.name: cookie
methods.description: Retrieve a value from the $_COOKIE superglobal array, returns null if not set.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Retrieve a header value via getallheaders(), returns null if header not found.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Decode incoming JSON payload from php://input, returns null if decoding fails.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Retrieve a session variable, starts session if not already active.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Placeholder method for future file handling, currently returns null.
